newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Senate committee approves Yellen as CEA chair.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Senate committee approves Yellen as CEA chair.

text.p: The Senate Banking Committee Wednesday approved the nomination of Janet Yellen as chairman of the White House Council of Economic Advisers.

Yellen, currently a member of the Federal Reserve Board, got the votes of 12 senators at a committee meeting. The other six members of the panel were expected to cast their votes for her later in the day.
The nomination now goes to the full Senate for confirmation. No time is set for the vote.
